title: Copy List with Random Pointer
problemStatement: A linked list consists of nodes containing: value next pointer random pointer, which may point to any node in the list or be null. Create a deep copy of the linked list and return the head of the copied list.
input: A linked list with next and random pointers.
output: The head of the deep-copied linked list.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 1000].
